title: Integers: Adding, Subtracting, Multiplying and Dividing
seo_title: Grade 8 Integers Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Perform calculations involving all four operations with integers; perform calculations involving all four operations with numbers that involve the squares, cubes, square roots and cube roots of integers; recognise and use commutative, associative and distributive properties, and additive and multiplicative inverses for integers.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 8 integers worksheets: adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing integers, squares, cubes and roots. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Same signs: positive. Different signs: negative.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Same signs give a positive answer: (−4) × (−5) = 20.
  • Different signs give a negative answer: (−24) ÷ 6 = −4.
  • (−3)² = 9, but (−2)³ = −8.
  • Subtracting a negative is the same as adding: 5 − (−3) = 8.

Examples

Example

(−6) × 4 − (−18) ÷ 3

−24 − (−6)

−24 + 6

Answer: −18
